en.headline: Around 1,000 civil servants take part in first large Huanggang Port transport drill
en.dek: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the stress test of the public transport interchange went smoothly and officials noted areas for improvement such as signage and queue control.
body: About 1,000 civil servants from more than 20 government departments took part on Thursday in the first large-scale public transport stress test at the Hong Kong side of the new Huanggang Port.

Participants arrived by bus, cross-boundary coach, minibus and taxi, passed through the departure and arrival halls, and repeated the process to simulate passenger and vehicle flows, involving more than 120 vehicle trips. The drill tested boarding and alighting, pedestrian and vehicle management, passageway capacity, signage and barrier-free facilities.

Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the exercise was meticulously arranged and went smoothly. Feedback included unclear signage and queue control issues, which officials would follow up. Further larger drills are planned later this month ahead of the port’s opening.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸逾千公務員參與公共運輸壓力測試 鄧炳強指順利
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示演練安排周密、過程順利，已識別指示牌及排隊管理等可改進範疇。
body: 政府跨部門團隊周四下午於新皇崗口岸港方口岸區舉行首次大型公共運輸壓力測試，約1,000名來自逾20個部門的公務員參與。
參與者以巴士、過境巴士、小巴及的士等不同公共交通工具抵達，穿梭出入境大堂後再返回交通交匯處離開，過程重複進行以模擬人流及車流，涉及逾120車次。演練涵蓋上落客、人車管理、通道容量、指示牌及無障礙設施等。
保安局局長鄧炳強表示演練安排周密、過程順利。部分參與者反映指示牌欠清晰及排隊管理等問題，當局已記錄並跟進改善。稍後本月將舉行更大規模演練，為口岸開通作準備。
